scope: Corollary B.3 (An explicit Whitney lift) of the manuscript “Topological triviality of mu-constant families of surface singularities” (preprints/Topological-triviality-of-mu-constant-families-of-surface-singularities-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 064 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 133a57483691850c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 34. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose that G satisfies the analytic and gradient hypotheses of Proposition B.1 and that (X∗, A) satisfies the Whitney conditions. Then G has the trivialization of that proposition. The fields on X∗ can be chosen to preserve ∥x∥2, and every constant real combination has the same property.
